name: computer-use
description: Control desktop apps on macOS from ChatGPT through Computer Use. Prefer purpose-built connectors, APIs, or CLIs.

interface.longDescription: Mac Computer Use lets ChatGPT use any app on your computer, including your web browsers and files you allow it to access. It may take screenshots or page content while working. You stay in control: you choose which apps to allow ChatGPT to access, you can stop actions at any time, and control whether we use screenshots for training.
